hmac_test_material.label: TEST ONLY. Per-record HMAC-SHA-256 used for data.reason_hmac in evt-0003. Real per-record HMAC material is kept off-chain and destroyed on erasure; it is derived here only so the vector is reproducible.

notes: event hash = lowercase hex SHA-256(JCS(event)) over the whole event, including orbanprevhash.
sequence starts at 00000000000000000001 and increases by one per event of the source.

notes: Leaves are JCS(event_i) in sequence order; leaf hash SHA-256(0x00 || leaf), node hash SHA-256(0x01 || left || right).
